answer: Reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so past endorsements lose influence unless an identity sustains honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality comes from normalized, trust-weighted interactions; a freshly spawned sybil has little incoming support and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust, and consensus thresholds exclude identities that lack sufficient standing. Names such as knoll, terrace, or haven confer no reputation.
